title: Knicks come back from 29 down, take Game 4 by 1 point
text:
The New York Knicks made a record comeback from 29 points down and moved to the brink of their first championship since 1973 by beating the San Antonio Spurs 107-106 on Wednesday night.
The Fort Greene community is gathering to cheer on the New York Knicks for Game 4 of the NBA Finals against the San Antonio Spurs.
